exposure: Knowledge of risks of prelacteal feeding
cohort: 719 mother-child pairs in Mettu district, Ethiopia
finding: Prelacteal feeding was common (14.2%) and associated with no maternal education, single ANC visit, not knowing the risks of prelacteal feeding, colostrum avoidance, home delivery, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with prelacteal feeding.
